'''''Isocoma hartwegii''''' is a Mexican plant species in the family [[Asteraceae]]. It has been found in the states of [[Jalisco]], [[Zacatecas]], [[Aguascalientes]], [[Hidalgo (state)|Hidalgo]], [[Guanajuato]], and [[San Luis Potosí]].<ref name=tammy/>

''Isocoma hartwegii'' is a subshrub. Each flower head has 13-22 [[disc flower]]s but no ray flowers.<ref name=tammy>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/12981103#page/3/mode/1up Nesom, G.L. 1991. Taxonomy of ''Isocoma'' (Compositae: Astereae). Phytologia 70(2): 69–114] description of ''I. humilis'' on pages 91-92, distribution map on page 73</ref>
